title: Sap Basis Technical Consultant
description:
Role Name: SAP BASIS Consultant Experience: 4 to 12 Years Location: Bangalore, Hyderabad, Pune, Chennai, Mangalore, Chandigarh, Trivandrum, Bhubaneswar, Nagpur, Jaipur, Indore, Coimbatore, Noida, Vizag, Kolkata, Mysore, Hubli Work Mode: Hybrid
 Roles & Responsibilities Install, configure, administer, and monitor SAP systems across landscapes. Perform SAP system upgrades, migrations, refreshes, and patching activities. Manage SAP S/4HANA, SAP NetWeaver, and HANA database environments. Execute client copies, system copies, kernel upgrades, and transport management activities. Monitor system performance and optimize SAP application and database performance. Perform user administration, role assignments, security, and authorization support. Handle SAP Backup, Recovery, Disaster Recovery, and High Availability configurations. Support incident management, problem resolution, and root cause analysis. Collaborate with functional, development, infrastructure, and cloud teams. Support implementation, upgrade, migration, and maintenance projects. Ensure system availability, reliability, and compliance with organizational standards. Mandatory Skills Strong hands-on experience in SAP BASIS Administration . Experience supporting SAP S/4HANA landscapes Experience in Kernal Upgrade and Solution Management . Strong knowledge of: SAP HANA Database Administration SAP NetWeaver Administration Transport Management System (TMS) SAP System Monitoring Performance Tuning Client Copy/System Copy Kernel Upgrades and Patch Management Experience in SAP installation, upgrade, and migration activities. Knowledge of SAP security, users, roles, and authorizations. Experience in troubleshooting SAP system performance issues. Understanding of Backup, Recovery, High Availability, and Disaster Recovery concepts. Experience in Linux/Unix operating systems. Strong analytical and stakeholder management skills. Preferred Skills SAP S/4HANA Conversion or Migration projects. Exposure to SAP Solution Manager. Experience with cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, or GCP. HANA database migration and administration experience.

Our current technical environment: Demonstrates strong technical expertise as required to support concerned solution, for e.g., DBMS (ex: SQL, Oracle) for application support; writing, reviewing, and improving queries, procedures etc. Troubleshooting Application issues Demonstrates strong expertise in contemporary SaaS technical toolsets like AppDynamics, Splunk etc.: To monitor application health and to investigate application issues. To analyze trends and draw conclusions to reduce/eliminate recurring/high impacting issues Databases - Oracle / SQL Server What you ll do: Delivers excellent customer experience by Understanding customer raised issues and take appropriate actions to resolve the same - Cloud /SaaS Reviewing the product source code or design document as necessary Owning and resolving all cases for global customers, adhering to defined SLA s Documenting learnings and creating knowledge articles for repeated cases Replicating and maintaining customer environments Maintaining knowledge of customer solutions and customization Demonstrating sense of urgency and swiftness with all customer interactions Acting as Techno-functional POC for all cases and ensure timely triage and assignment Utilizing instant messenger and other tools to collaborate globally Working in shifts and being flexible with the timings Meeting organization and team level goals Improving Customer Satisfaction by providing quality and timely solutions to reported issues and follow-up until case closure Identifying areas of improvement and scope of automation on routine tasks or activities Helping in meeting team level goals and being a team player What we are looking for: Bachelor s degree (STEM preferred) and minimum 5 to 7 years. Strong DBMS (ex: SQL, Oracle) skill set with at least 3-4 years hands on. Good Communication and Strong Analytical Skills Person with prior support experience with fair knowledge on handling issues within SLA s Preferably Blue Yonder TMS knowledge, Platform knowledge else basic Supply Chain domain experience Person who can communicate flawless with Customer and other stakeholders. Associates in rotational shifts (including early/late shifts as applicable) is required. Participation in weekend on-call rotations and high-severity incident support outside standard business hours is mandatory. Availability during critical production outages and major incidents is expected to ensure service continuity.
